title: Atomic JSON writes for backtest artifacts
problem: The latest same-date backtest artifact was malformed with trailing data after a complete JSON object, which can corrupt Gate 1 baselines and future experiment comparisons.
change: Route backtest result, OHLCV snapshot, and entry-candidate JSON artifact saves through a same-directory temp file plus os.replace.
acceptance_evidence: data/backtests/backtest_results_20260522.json had extra trailing data after the first parsed object.
Atomic helper probe wrote parseable JSON and left no .tmp files behind.
py_compile passed for quant/backtester.py and the new exp015 script.
follow_up: Do not use the malformed 20260522 artifact as a trusted baseline unless regenerated.
